name: Where Them Logs App
description: Where Them Logs App is a searchable catalog of where applications write their log files on Windows, macOS and Linux, including the Intune Management Extension, Company Portal and common third-party apps. Paths are shown verbatim with environment variables unexpanded, so they paste straight into remediation scripts. It also exposes a no-key MCP server for AI agents, and missing apps or wrong paths can be reported through GitHub issues.
author: Scott McAllister

securityCheck.aiSummary: No obfuscated code or remote code execution detected. Primary risks are information disclosure on the 403 admin page and potential data leakage through external sharing of log paths. Recommend tightening what is surfaced on error pages and auditing/public posting of internal log paths.
